comments.author: @AtlasDiscover1
comments.text: The sheer vertical drop of those Alpine peaks in car-free zones like Zermatt makes the air feel insanely crisp and pure. Seeing quiet electric carts glide past centuries-old wooden chalets really highlights their uncompromising commitment to protecting mountain air quality. That absolute lack of engine noise completely changes how you experience high-altitude wilderness!
